survey: A DJ controller seen from a high three-quarter view, resting flat on an orange floor, with headphones lying beside it. The controller has three joined modules: a left deck, a center mixer and a right deck. Each module is a thick slab with a darker base, and the modules step slightly back from left to right, which reads as a deliberate staggered layout. Both decks have a round jog wheel on top, drawn as a flattened ellipse. Both ellipses are about equally narrow and match the angle of the top face. Rows of colored pads and small screens on the decks run parallel to the module edges, and they shrink a little toward the back. On the center mixer, a raised display block stands on the top face. The knobs are short cylinders seen from the same height, and the fader slots run parallel to the front edge. The headphones lie on the floor in front of the right deck. Their ear cups are tilted ellipses, and the headband arcs over the cups in a way that fits a headset resting on its side under the same high camera. All front-edge lines share one direction, as do all depth lines, and the base meets the floor flat with a matching soft shadow.
